name: evey-plugin-weather-v2

scripts.build: esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --format=iife --target=es2019 --minify --outfile=dist/index.js --loader:.jpg=dataurl && esbuild src/settings/index.ts --bundle --format=iife --target=es2019 --minify --outfile=dist/settings.js && cp src/assets/sun_aia171.jpg dist/sun-live-aia171.jpg

comment: The front module has ZERO runtime dependencies: raw WebGL + vanilla DOM, bundled by esbuild. Only the nodejs backend stub (main.js) needs runtime deps, so only @grpc ships in node_modules. This keeps the bundle ~25x smaller than v1 (three.js/React) and removes their memory overhead entirely.
